body_html:
@OccamsCleaver Like a Central Scrutinizer???...that be pretty neat

Again, original thread was about best way to support computational thinking. I disagree that content of Western civ course is most efficient.

Then noted that a myopic view of "Western Civ" glory advances a single story and leaves some histories unwritten.
